account.title: Your MeteoVeo account
account.subtitle: Free. Your password is used once to sign in and is never stored on your Homey.
account.marketing: Send me MeteoVeo news by e-mail (optional).
account.passwordless: Did you sign up with Google, Apple or a passkey? Set a password first in the MeteoVeo app (Account → Password).

verify.title: Check your e-mail
verify.subtitle: We sent you a 6-digit code.
verify.hint: Nothing arrived? Look in the spam folder; the code is valid for 15 minutes.

location.title: Where is home?
location.subtitle: Your Homey's location, rounded to about 1 km. You can change it.
location.hint: MeteoVeo covers Spain, the Balearic and Canary Islands, Ceuta and Melilla.

station.title: Do you have a weather station?
station.subtitle: Optional. Its readings make the forecast for your home more accurate, and you can follow your station in the MeteoVeo app.
station.devices: Yes, choose its devices in Homey
station.flow: Yes, I will send readings with Flows
station.height_hint: Used to compare your readings with nearby stations.
station.flow_hint: After pairing, add a Flow such as: When the temperature of your station changes → MeteoVeo: Send temperature.

repair.title: MeteoVeo
repair.login_hint: If this location shows as unavailable, sign in again to issue a new key. Your settings stay.
repair.delete_explain: This deletes your MeteoVeo account, your saved places and your station data, on every device. Your public observations stay, without your name.
repair.delete_confirm: Type your e-mail address again to confirm
repair.delete_last_chance: Your MeteoVeo account will be deleted for good. Continue?

errors.invalid_email: That e-mail address does not look right.
errors.weak_password: The password needs at least 8 characters.
errors.terms_required: To create an account, accept the terms of use and the privacy policy.
errors.invalid_code: That code is not right, or it has expired.
errors.invalid_credentials: Wrong e-mail or password. If you signed up with Google, Apple or a passkey, set a password in the MeteoVeo app first.
errors.registration_closed: New accounts cannot be created right now. Please try again later.
errors.invalid_location: That location is outside the area MeteoVeo covers (Spain and its islands).
errors.too_many_keys: Your account already has 5 connected locations. Remove one in Home Assistant or Homey first.
errors.unknown_station: That station does not belong to your account.
errors.signup_first: Start again from the first step.
errors.confirm_mismatch: The e-mail addresses do not match.
errors.unavailable: MeteoVeo cannot be reached right now. It will try again by itself.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.signed_out: Not signed in. Use Repair to sign in again.
errors.key_revoked: The connection was revoked. Use Repair to sign in again.
errors.no_nowcast: There is no next-hour forecast for this location right now.
errors.no_station: This location has no weather station. Remove it and pair it again to add one.
errors.measurement_from_device: This measurement already comes from a device chosen during pairing.
errors.station_key_rejected: MeteoVeo rejected the station key. Remove this location and pair it again.
errors.no_sources: Choose at least one device, or pick the Flow option.

notifications.account_deleted: Your MeteoVeo account was deleted. You can now remove the MeteoVeo devices.

widget.dry: No rain in the next hour
